newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish refiner Petrochemia Plock to raise prices.
newsitem.headline: Polish refiner Petrochemia Plock to raise prices.

text.p: Petrochemia Plock SA, Poland's largest oil refinery, will increase fuel prices slightly on Monday, the firm's deputy president told daily Gazeta Wyborcza in its Saturday edition.
"The rise is slight. Petrol will rise by 10 zlotys a tonne, diesel by 20 zlotys a tonne," Marek Mroczkowski was quoted as saying.

The paper said the move could translate into a one-zloty retail rise in petrol prices, two zlotys in diesel, and resulted from higher international crude oil prices and the recent appreciation of the dollar versus the zloty.
Petrochemia Plock and refiner Rafineria Gdansk SA are to be partially sold off next year under the government's oil sector privatisation scheme.
